text:
maya-cs: FYI AcadiaHealth hit 403 on text generation immediately after we flipped them to the new SSO provisioning pipeline. They can still do embeddings/rerank but any `generate` endpoints return 403.
sam-eng: thanks — can you paste the decoded JWT payload from one of their failing requests? want to see scopes/claims
maya-cs: pasted (redacted tenant id):
```
{
  "sub": "svc-acadia-01",
  "entitlements": ["embeddings","rerank"],
  "iss": "https://idp.example.com",
  "exp": 1730000000
}
```
maya-cs: note: `generate` is missing from entitlements even though customer claims they already had that permission pre-migration
linus-sre: quick thought — our authorizer historically reads `scope`/`scp` as a space-delimited string. this looks like the new provisioner wrote a JSON array into `entitlements` instead of a string
sam-eng: yeah — we updated the provisioner to emit structured entitlements for SCIM v2, but the authorizer codepath for service tokens doesn't parse arrays. it only checks `if 'generate' in scopes_string.split()`
tori-cs: customer says they DID see `generate` in the SCIM preview. maybe mapping change removed it from the array. they're blocked in production.
sam-eng: repro steps I used: curl to /v1/chat with header `Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>` then decode token: `echo $TOKEN | cut -d. -f2 | base64 -d | jq .` - shows entitlements array above
sam-eng: minimal fix options:
- quick: relax authorizer to accept JSON arrays in `entitlements` when present (patch on master + hotfix).
- bandaid: an ingress transform (nginx/lua) that converts `entitlements` array into `scope` string for our authorizer.
- long: make provisioner emit both `scope` string and `entitlements` array for backwards compatibility.
linus-sre: can we do the ingress transform as an emergency? I can push a small lua snippet to the sidecar pool for the affected tenant.
maya-cs: customer wants ETA and mitigation. they have 3k users hitting generation endpoints; high priority.
sam-eng: sample lua transform I tested locally (very light):
```
-- parse JSON body, if jwt payload.entitlements is array -> join with ' ' -> set header "x-roles-scope"
local ent = payload.entitlements
if type(ent) == 'table' then
  ngx.req.set_header('x-roles-scope', table.concat(ent, ' '))
end
```
sam-eng: I'll open a PR to accept arrays in the authorizer and add a schema test. that should be low-risk.
deploy-bot: ticket CS-18291 created for AcadiaHealth, severity P1, linked to ENG-5497 (authorizer compat)
tori-cs: added customer contact + logs to CS-18291. asked them to retry after the ingress transform.
linus-sre: rolling a quick ingress patch to the ac-realm sidecars now, will patch for tenant id `acadia-prod` only.
maya-cs: customer confirms reduced error rate in first 10m after ingress transform applied — some older tokens still failing (likely cached tokens)
sam-eng: will land authorizer fix in canary after tests and then roll to prod today. also adding unit test: handle both "entitlements":"embeddings rerank generate" and "entitlements":["embeddings","generate"]
tori-cs: customer wants a permanent remediation plan. suggest updating provisioner to emit legacy `scope` claim as string for 6 months, then deprecate.
sam-eng: agreed — will coordinate with provisioner team. action items attached to ENG-5497.
maya-cs: thanks team — passing to customer: we’ve applied a temporary ingress transform, canarying a code fix, and will follow up with a provisioner compatibility plan. :thumbsup:
